core_obligations: Factor the morphism: write the given morphism as the composite of the arrow into the fibre product with the projection, the standard factorization through the fibre product over the base (proof lines 5226-5228)
Properties of the second factor: the projection is locally quasi-finite as a base change of the given locally quasi-finite morphism (proof lines 5229-5231)
Properties of the first factor: it is locally quasi-finite because the intermediate morphism is quasi-DM, which is exactly the semi-diagonal statement (proof lines 5232-5233)
proof_roadmap: 把 X → Y 分解为 X → X ×_Z Y → Y。
第二支是 X → Z 的基变换 ⇒ 局部拟有限；第一支由 Y → Z 准 DM 的「半对角」引理 ⇒ 局部拟有限。
由复合保持局部拟有限得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for morphisms of algebraic stacks with the composite locally quasi-finite and the middle morphism quasi-DM, the first morphism is locally quasi-finite (author lemma at source lines 5217-5223, label lemma-locally-quasi-finite-permanence). The proof (source lines 5225-5240) factors the morphism through the fibre product over the base, obtains local quasi-finiteness of the projection by base change and of the factorization arrow from the semi-diagonal statement for the quasi-DM morphism, and concludes by composition permanence (proof lines 5226-5236). The factorization and the two permanence steps are the content. H3.
